environment.camera: Unmodified actual game camera at default spawn (-8,8), same orthographic framing
environment.sampling: 12 warmup frames and 24 requestAnimationFrame intervals per captured scenario

evidence_limits: A separate QA browser ran concurrently during part of these captures. Software timings therefore are not a controlled performance comparison.
No iPad, Safari, hardware GPU, 30 FPS or 60 FPS completion claim is supported.
Battlerite reference screenshots were mentioned but were not supplied.
Candidate low was intentionally cancelled before capture at parent request, to release software-renderer capacity for functional QA.

submitted_work_delta.interpretation: Candidate submits fewer draw calls and more triangles; there is no demonstrated hardware frame-rate improvement.

improvements: Primitive faceted canopy masses replaced by spatial leaf-and-branch crowns with distinct birch, broadleaf and conifer silhouettes.
Buildings have visible roof-shingle texture, stone foundation, timber framing, window boxes, porch details and distinct roof palettes.
Ground, foliage and lighting form a more restrained forest palette; character proportions are more human.
Spawn, gameplay HUD, hearts, weapon loot and minimap remain visible in actual gameplay view.
remaining_limits: Tall-grass patches still have conspicuous compact geometric edge profiles rather than a fully natural meadow transition.
Some leaf sprig repetition is visible on close inspection; generated foliage is an art pass, not hand-painted production foliage.
Roof texture repetition is visible at this camera distance, though material detail is substantially improved.
visual_review.defects_observed: No missing textures, broken shaders, black geometry or obscured player observed in these spawn captures.
